protocol.hypothesis: Larger startup/resume buffers may reduce full-playback stalls at a cost in startup or resume waiting
protocol.session_selection: First four unused ferry sessions in archive filename order; selected from directory metadata, before viewing trace values
protocol.decision_rule: Compare all predeclared profiles; do not promote or select a winner using these four sessions
limitations: Same VOD and ferry route, four additional sessions only
Frozen DQN was trained with startup/resume thresholds of 1 s; changed context is untrained
Thresholds are media seconds; whole segments arrive together (first segment 3.9934 s)
All nine profiles share these sessions; this is exploratory comparison, not independent validation of a selected profile
Observed goodput replay, RTT assumed 80 ms; no packet/radio simulation

provenance.network_model: finite application-goodput replay; no TCP/QUIC/radio/packet model
provenance.quality_model: playback-duration-weighted log bitrate proxy; not VMAF/MOS
provenance.latency_metric: live edge minus playhead; wall-time weighted after startup, including stalls
